title: Settings Page
content: Create settings page layout and structure. Layout: sidebar navigation + main content area. Navigation: sections like Account, Privacy, Notifications, Appearance, Billing. Section structure: heading, description, settings controls. Control types: toggle switches, dropdowns, radio groups. Toggle pattern: label left, switch right. Save behavior: auto-save on change with toast, or explicit Save button. Responsive: on mobile, nav becomes accordion.

variants.simple: Create settings page with sidebar navigation and toggle controls.
variants.detailed: Create settings page layout and structure. Layout: sidebar navigation + main content area. Navigation: sections like Account, Privacy, Notifications, Appearance, Billing. Section structure: heading, description, settings controls. Control types: toggle switches, dropdowns, radio groups. Toggle pattern: label left, switch right. Save behavior: auto-save on change with toast, or explicit Save button. Responsive: on mobile, nav becomes accordion.
variants.advanced: Create settings page layout and structure with comprehensive UX. Layout: flex row on desktop - sidebar navigation (w-64 flex-shrink-0) + main content area (flex-1 max-w-2xl). Sidebar navigation: sticky top-4, space-y-1. Nav items: px-3 py-2 rounded-lg, hover:bg-gray-100, active state (bg-gray-100 font-medium). Sections: Account, Privacy & Security, Notifications, Appearance, Billing, Help & Support. Section icons: User, Shield, Bell, Palette, CreditCard, HelpCircle from lucide. Main content: px-6 py-4 overflow-y-auto. Section structure: heading (text-xl font-semibold mb-1), description (text-sm text-gray-500 mb-6), settings controls grouped in cards or bordered sections. Control types and patterns: Toggle switches (label on left, switch on right, optional description below in text-sm text-gray-500), Select dropdowns (for multi-option choices), Radio groups (for mutually exclusive options, vertical stack with descriptions), Text inputs (for editable values like name, email). Toggle pattern: flex justify-between items-center py-4 border-b, label column (label text + optional description), switch aligned right. Save behavior: auto-save on change with brief success toast ("Settings saved"), loading state on control during save, error toast with retry on failure. Alternative: explicit "Save Changes" button at bottom with unsaved changes indicator. Grouping: related settings in cards (bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm p-4) or sections with border-b separators. Search: filter/search input at top to find settings by keyword, highlights matching sections. Reset: "Reset to defaults" option per section or global with confirmation. Responsive: on mobile (md:hidden), sidebar becomes horizontal scrolling tabs at top, accordion sections, or hamburger menu. Full-width content area. Loading: skeleton for settings values while fetching. Error handling: inline errors below controls, retry option. Unsaved changes: warning modal on navigation away ("You have unsaved changes. Discard?"). Help links: question mark icons linking to documentation per setting. Accessibility: proper form labels, fieldset/legend for groups, announce save confirmations.
